statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Continuous Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and optimize anticoagulation management
The denial reason is PR-204 (service not covered under member's current benefit plan)
